description: The engine answers `400` with `x-rivet-error: depot.overloaded` while its storage layer is starting (about a minute after a fresh control plane reports healthy) or under load (observed against rivet-engine 3.0.0-preview.4). Type it as a retryable StorageOverloaded on every operation so the default retry policy rides it out instead of surfacing BadRequest.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The control plane's storage refused the command (`depot.overloaded`) — answered while the storage layer is still starting or under load. Retry after a short delay.
